lesson: Count to ten and know that the last number counted tells how many there are.

pages.art: Wide view of rolling hills above a small village at the end of an autumn day. The sky is flat bands of gold, peach and soft purple; the sun is a half disc sinking behind the far hill. Dry golden grass, a few grey rocks, one old carob tree as a dark round shape on the slope. Rafi and his aunt stand on the hillside, small, among ten goats grazing (one goat puppet repeated in brown, grey and black-and-white, with Speckle the smallest: white with brown speckles, at the edge). Feeling: calm, golden, the end of a good day. Calm area: the sky across the top.

A stony path winds down the hill toward the village. The goats walk down it in a line, bells swinging under their chins; Auntie walks in front with her staff, Rafi in the middle of the line. Last of all, a little apart, Speckle stretches her neck to nibble a dry flower beside the path. Feeling: a happy, bouncy procession; a smile at the little one at the back. Calm area: the plain hillside in the bottom band.

A low stone wall makes a goat pen at the edge of the village, with a wooden gate swung open. Rafi stands by the gate post, one finger pointing. A goat is in mid-jump through the gateway; two goats are already inside; the rest wait on the path. Auntie leans on the wall, watching him. Feeling: a game, a counting beat. No numbers anywhere in the picture. Calm area: the evening sky across the top.

Inside view of the pen: nine goats settling, one still mid-hop. Outside the gate, the stony path is empty, going up into the dusk. Rafi stands proud, chin up, hands on hips. Feeling: pleased with himself, a job done (so he thinks). Calm area: the empty path and sky across the top.

Close on Auntie and Rafi at the gate. Auntie has stopped, eyebrows raised, looking from the goats to Rafi; one hand lifted as if to say 'wait'. Rafi's proud smile is slipping into a puzzled look. Behind them the goats munch, unconcerned. Feeling: a little surprise, not alarm. Calm area: the stone wall in the bottom band.

Rafi walks slowly among the goats inside the pen, one hand resting on a goat's warm back; small soft curved lines show each touch (no letters). He is concentrating, tongue at the corner of his mouth. Nine goats in a loose row. Feeling: careful, serious counting. Calm area: the sky above the pen, across the top.

A row of goat faces looking at the reader, each a little different: the big brown goat, the old grey goat with a beard, a black-and-white one, and the others. At the end of the row an empty space, drawn as a soft gap of straw. Rafi peers along the row, finger on his chin. Feeling: a guessing game the child can join. Calm area: the plain straw floor in the bottom band.

Rafi and Auntie walk back up the stony path, holding hands, Auntie's staff in her other hand. The light is purple now; long soft shadows; the hills are flat bands of violet and dark blue. Rafi has one hand cupped at his mouth, calling. The grass bends a little in the wind. Feeling: a small worry, but together. Calm area: the darkening sky across the top.

Higher on the hill, near the old carob tree, a dark round shape against the violet sky. The first star is a single small point of light. Rafi stands very still, head tilted, listening; Auntie behind him with a finger to her lips. From the shadow under the tree, two tiny curved sound lines. Feeling: hush, listening, hope. Calm area: the sky across the top, around the star.

Under the carob tree: Speckle, the smallest goat, white with brown speckles, wedged snugly between two grey rocks, completely calm, chewing a purple thistle flower, one ear flopped. Rafi bends towards her, laughing with relief. Feeling: relief and a laugh. Calm area: the dark ground in the bottom band.

Rafi kneels and lifts Speckle out from between the rocks, his arms around her middle; Auntie kneels beside him with her hands ready to help, laughing. Speckle's legs kick a little; a bit of thistle still in her mouth. Feeling: warm, funny, safe. Calm area: the starry sky across the top.

Back at the pen in the starlight. Rafi stands at the open gate pointing at the goats inside, counting; Speckle is in mid-hop through the gateway, the last one in. Auntie watches from the wall, smiling. No numbers in the picture. Feeling: excitement building to the last beat. Calm area: the night sky across the top.

Night. Auntie closes the wooden gate; inside, ten goats are settling down together, Speckle curled against the big brown goat. Rafi leans on the gate, looking up at a sky with a scattering of stars, smiling. A few warm windows glow in the village below. Last picture of the book: peaceful and complete. Calm area: the sky across the top.

shots.action: 12 s. Scene 1, evening on the hills. Fade up on flat bands of gold and purple sky; the sun sinks slowly behind the far hill. Slow pan across the slope to the goats grazing. Keep the lower fifth calm for captions in every shot.
sound: a few goat bells, far away

shots.action: 8 s. Auntie lifts her staff and calls; one by one the goats raise their heads. Rafi skips to her side.
10 s. The goats trot down the stony path in a line (one goat puppet repeated, colours varied), bells swinging in time with the music. No words: let the procession bounce.
8 s. At the back, Speckle stops to nibble a dry flower. Rafi turns round and beckons with both hands; Speckle trots to catch up.
sound: a quick trot of little hooves

shots.action: 7 s. Wide: the line of goats winding down towards the village; the sky turning peach.
8 s. Scene 2, the count. Auntie swings the wooden gate of the stone pen open; Rafi takes his place by the gate post.
12 s. The goats hop through the gate one per beat while Rafi points at each. Each hop lands on a soft drum beat. The numbers are only heard, never shown.
sound: one soft drum beat per goat

shots.action: 10 s. Four more hops on the beat. Then the beat stops: the path behind the gate is empty. Hold 2 s on the empty path.
4 s. Rafi, proud, hands on hips.
7 s. Auntie stops; her eyebrows rise; she looks from the pen to Rafi.
5 s. Rafi's puzzled face turns determined. He nods.
14 s. Inside the pen, Rafi walks slowly from goat to goat, a hand on each warm back. Each touch makes a soft plink. He counts quietly; we hear only the end of the count.
sound: a soft plink for each touch

shots.action: 6 s. Rafi's hand on the last goat. Beyond it, an empty patch of straw. No words; hold.
8 s. Quick close-ups along the row of goat faces: the big brown goat, the old grey goat, the black-and-white goat. The last place is empty.
6 s. Rafi turns and looks up at the darkening path. The music becomes quieter and a little worried. No words.
7 s. Auntie shuts the gate on the nine goats and holds out her hand; Rafi takes it. No words.
12 s. Scene 3, the search. Rafi and Auntie climb the stony path in purple light, long shadows behind them. Rafi cups his hands and calls.
7 s. The grass bands sway in the wind. Nobody answers.
10 s. The first star blinks on, a tiny point of light. Rafi stops and stands very still; Auntie puts a finger to her lips. Hold 3 s of silence.
sound: a single soft chime for the star

shots.action: 7 s. The camera drifts slowly towards the dark round shape of the old carob tree.
4 s. From under the tree: a tiny bleat. Rafi's head turns. No words.
8 s. Scene 4, found. Under the tree, Speckle sits wedged between two rocks, calmly chewing a thistle; the purple flower bobs as she chews. Rafi laughs with relief.
6 s. Auntie laughs and shakes her head.
8 s. Rafi kneels and lifts Speckle out, arms round her middle; Auntie's hands are ready beside him. Speckle kicks once and settles.
12 s. Walking down the hill under the stars: Speckle trots close at Rafi's heels, Auntie beside them. Warm music; no words.
9 s. Scene 5, ten. At the pen, Rafi points at each goat inside on the soft drum beat, as before.
sound: one soft drum beat per goat

shots.action: 6 s. On the tenth beat Speckle hops through the gate, the last one in. A bright chord.
7 s. Auntie closes the gate and smiles at Rafi.
7 s. Rafi leans on the gate and looks up at the stars.

14 s. Closing image: the pen at night, ten goats settling together, Speckle curled against the big brown goat; stars come out slowly in the sky. Hold the still picture 6 s while the music ends, then stop. No autoplay.
sound: the last notes of the music

steps.picture: A child and a grown-up kneel by a chalk 'pen' of ten squares (two rows of five) on a pavement; one big pinecone sits in each square. The child touches each pinecone with one finger, counting.
The child covers both eyes with their hands. The grown-up lifts one pinecone out of its square and hides it behind their back.
The child counts again, touching each pinecone; one square is empty. The grown-up shows the hidden pinecone, smiling. Two curved arrows between the child and the grown-up show that they swap roles.
